title: handle_group_live calls list_groups() on every GROUP command (N+1 query)
description:
## What / Why
In crates/reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs, handle_group_live() calls stores.article_numbers.list_groups() to determine if a group is carried, then calls stores.article_numbers.group_range() separately. list_groups() returns all groups; contains() then scans the full list for the one requested group. This is two sequential SQLite queries per GROUP command where one targeted query would suffice. More importantly, list_groups() materializes all groups into memory on every GROUP command, which is O(number_of_groups) allocation per command.

## Trigger → Bad Behavior
A server with thousands of groups and a client that repeatedly issues GROUP commands (e.g. Thunderbird on initial sync) → O(groups) allocation and two SQLite queries per GROUP command instead of O(1).

## Fix
Add a group_exists(name) or lookup_group(name) method to ArticleNumberStore that performs a single targeted query, replacing the list_groups()+contains() pattern in handle_group_live.
